content: If the SYSERR flag is set, wakeup shall be reported to EcuM through API EcuM_SetWakeupEvent with a wakeup source value, which has a “1” at the bit position according to the symbolic name value referred by CanTrcvSyserrWakeupSour ceRef , and “0” on all others.
